title: Ongoing support in a mentoring exercise
method: Synthetic example: eight questions ×20 minutes =160. Follow-up: three ×20 plus 20 minutes upkeep =80. The120-minute preparation is excluded from ongoing effort; 120/(160−80)=1.5 weeks simple recovery. This is not evidence of an intervention effect.
alt: Two bars compare 160 and 80 minutes of ongoing support per week.
